title: Journal Scope: Neurological Foundations of Dysgraphia and Graphomotor Impairments
author: Research Team
summary: An editorial overview outlining the diagnostic boundaries, sub-types (spatial, motor, and dyslexic dysgraphia), and neurological mechanisms of graphomotor learning disabilities.

title: Kinematic Analysis of Handwriting in Developmental Dysgraphia: Fine Motor Velocity, Pen Pressure, and Digital Scaffolding
author: Research Team & Hesten Allison
summary: This empirical investigation utilizes digitized graphic tablets to measure stroke duration, velocity profiles, and pen-tip pressure variations in students with developmental dysgraphia.

title: Occupational Therapy Adaptations and Assistive Writing Technologies in K-12 Classrooms
author: Research Team
summary: A comprehensive review of evidence-based classroom accommodations, biomechanical modifications, speech-to-text tools, and structured graphomotor interventions.
